subject.title: fix(zai): add user-agent header to endpoint detection probe

question: Should maintainers keep this one-line PR as the canonical Z.AI User-Agent fix after adding proof/tests, or choose a better-tested sibling PR for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98100?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but the proof is mock-only, the branch has no regression test, and multiple open PRs target the same provider-onboarding bug.

options.title: Choose a tested canonical branch
